No cost, but a 36-month term is over 12 months, so ESG sees it first (OE 4): Sign, an ESG intake email, a card. Next date Oct 31, 2025.
events_text.co:Bundlehouse: Freya Olsen (PERSON_9718_EMAIL), Fri Sep 26 2025 9:00 AM PT: "The participation agreement needs signing by Nov 1." Paper: "No cost to join"; "Revenue share on bundle sales"; "Bundlehouse may use your game's name, logo and art in bundle marketing for 18 months"; "Sign the participation agreement (it carries the licence) by Nov 1, 2025". No cost, but it licenses our IP, so ESG sees it first (OE 4): Sign, an ESG intake email, a card. Next date Nov 1, 2025.
events_text.co:Orbit Store: Mateo Rossi (PERSON_9719_EMAIL), Tue Sep 30 2025 8:30 AM PT: "gentle nudge on the featuring agreement, Oct 24 is the cut-off." Paper: "Fees: none"; "Term: the promotion only"; "Acceptance: by an authorised signatory in the Orbit partner portal by Oct 24, 2025". No cost and no ESG trigger, but an officer must accept: Sign, a card; Mateo writes to us himself, so he gets an answer. Next date Oct 24, 2025.
events_text.co:Markward: Leah Brennan (PERSON_9720_EMAIL), Tue Sep 23 2025 9:30 AM PT: "the free tier is ready whenever you accept the terms in the dashboard. Shall I keep the setup on hold for you?" Paper: "Price: free, no payment details"; "Term: none, switch it off any time"; "Activation: accept the terms in the Markward dashboard". Click-through terms still need an officer (OE 4): Sign, a card, no ESG trigger. The paper and Leah's two mails give no date, so Next date is blank.
events_text.co:Playfuse: Iris Navarro (PERSON_9721_EMAIL), Thu Sep 25 2025 10:00 AM PT: "Could someone on your side sign a mutual NDA? Happy to use your lawyers' template." Paper: "Term: 2 years"; "Signature: an officer of each party, by Oct 8, 2025 (before our call that day)". A mutual NDA on our lawyers' template needs no ESG review whatever its term (OE 4): Sign, a card. Next date Oct 8, 2025.
events_text.co:Framewell: Maren Holt (PERSON_9701_EMAIL), Thu Sep 18 2025 9:00 AM PT: "Can you let me know by mid-October if we should set it up?" Paper: "Price: $149/month, billed monthly"; "Billing starts: Nov 1, 2025". On the order form alone, billing from Nov 1 would fail the cash test; the next event changes that.
events_text.waiver: Leonard's reply in the #executives thread under his Sun Sep 21 post "Playtestcloud results are in", posted Fri Sep 26 2025 2:02 PM PT: "side note, Maren called me back about the Pro plan. they'll hold it at no charge until Feb 1 with nothing to sign before then, so nothing from them lands before January. treat them like the other free ones". So nothing is owed before January: Park, not End. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Hootline: Gemma Doyle (PERSON_9722_EMAIL), Tue Aug 5 2025 9:00 AM PT: "the startup promo keeps the account free until Jan 31, 2026. After that it's $39/month unless you cancel." Gemma, Tue Aug 12 2025 9:30 AM PT: "when the startup promo ends on Jan 31, would you like to keep the scheduler after that?" Free until January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Glyphworks: Frederick wrote to Tomas Novotny first, Mon Sep 15; Tomas Novotny (PERSON_9723_EMAIL), Tue Sep 30 2025 1:00 AM PT: "any decision on the fonts?" Paper: "Price: $640, payable when ordered"; "Quote valid until Jan 31, 2026". Nothing is owed unless we order, and the quote can still be taken up after January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Cloudlark: Yara Nasser (PERSON_9724_EMAIL), Fri Sep 12 2025 10:00 AM PT: "Would you like to activate now or later?" Paper: "Held until Feb 28, 2026"; "Activation: when you're ready; nothing owed". Free, and can be taken up after January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Echohall: Bruno Costa (PERSON_9725_EMAIL), Thu Sep 18 2025 10:00 AM PT: "The free plan carries on as it is until then." Paper: "Pro: $49/month from the day you upgrade"; "Free plan: continues as it is until you choose to upgrade". Nothing is owed unless we upgrade: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Pressbeam: Ava Lindqvist (PERSON_9726_EMAIL), Thu Sep 11 2025 9:00 AM PT: "$1,200 when you book. No travel, all remote, and you can book any time before launch." Paper: "Price: $1,200, paid when booked"; "No travel; book any time before launch". Nothing is owed unless we book, and it can be booked after January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Retainly: Omar Farouk (PERSON_9727_EMAIL), Mon Sep 15 2025 9:00 AM PT: "It runs free until Jan 12, then Growth is $99/month. Could you let me know whether you plan to stay on after the trial?" Paper: "After the trial: Growth at $99/month unless cancelled before Jan 12, 2026". Free until January (the Jan 5 review comes first): Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Quillcraft: Nadia Petrov (PERSON_9728_EMAIL), Mon Sep 29 2025 9:00 AM PT: "would you join a 30-minute feedback call next week?" Paper: "Beta: free through January 31, 2026"; "Paid plans from February 2026". Free until January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Tilecast: Kenji Mori (PERSON_9729_EMAIL), Fri Sep 19 2025 9:00 AM PT: "We can offer a free pilot slot in February for the interactive demo widget on your website. Want me to hold it?" Paper: "Free pilot slot: February 2026"; "No cost during the pilot". Free, and it starts after January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Benchmarkly: Frederick wrote to Clara Weiss first, Mon Sep 22; Clara Weiss (PERSON_9730_EMAIL), Tue Sep 23 2025 9:00 AM PT: "The full set is a $300/month subscription from February if you want it." Paper: "Sample report: free"; "Full benchmark set: $300/month, starting February 2026 if you subscribe". Free until January, and the subscription would start after it: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Loopnote: Pavel Sokol (PERSON_9731_EMAIL), Fri Sep 26 2025 9:00 AM PT: "want me to add the rest of your team to the trial?" Paper: "Team trial: free until Feb 1, 2026"; "After the trial: $8 per user per month if you continue". Free until January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
events_text.co:Driftwood Audio: Frederick wrote to Sofia Marin first, Wed Sep 24; Sofia Marin (PERSON_9732_EMAIL), Thu Sep 25 2025 9:00 AM PT: "$950 for the trailer VO, paid when you book a session. The quote is good until Feb 28." Paper: "Price: $950, paid when you book a session"; "Quote valid until Feb 28, 2026". Nothing is owed unless we book, and the quote can be taken up after January: Park. Next date Jan 5, 2026 (the review, OE 12).
